title: Powermark
summary: Powermark sacrifices a Titan and gives the Seeker who used this spell its energy, based on the Titan's level of power. When used in conjunction with Doublespell, the Titan's energy can be shared between two Seekers.

sections.heading: History
sections.wikitext:
[[Harrison Fears]] used this spell to sacrifice a [[Bazela's Insect]] Titan outside the [[Tomb of Tutankhamun]] in order to re-energise and quickly recover from a defeat by the Huntik team and plan an ambush. {{source|Rassimov's Secret}}

In order to save [[Zhalia Moon]] from [[the Betrayer]], Harrison used [[Doublespell]] with Powermark to sacrifice [[Kilthane]] and split the energy between him and [[Den Fears]], reenergising him and reviving his brother. {{Source|Lok and the Betrayer}}

== History ==
[[Harrison Fears]] used this spell to sacrifice a [[Bazela's Insect]] Titan outside the [[Tomb of Tutankhamun]] in order to re-energise and quickly recover from a defeat by the Huntik team and plan an ambush. {{source|Rassimov's Secret}}
